requirements: Users can create an account and manage a personal profile.
Users can log meals, snacks, and drinks with quantities and timestamps.
Users can search or select foods from a nutrition database.
Users can track calories, macronutrients, and other nutrition goals.
Users can edit or delete previously entered food logs.
Users can view daily, weekly, and monthly nutrition summaries.
Users can set diet goals and receive progress feedback.
Users can export or share nutrition reports.
The system should protect personal nutrition data with secure authentication.
The interface should be responsive on desktop and mobile devices.
Food search and meal logging should feel fast and remain responsive.
The system should store user history reliably and support backups.
The application should be easy to use for first-time users.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate stakeholder input may lead to incomplete or inaccurate requirements.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage with stakeholders through multiple channels to ensure comprehensive requirements gathering.

risk_report.risk: Incompatible technology stack selection may cause integration issues and performance problems.
risk_report.mitigation: Research and evaluate technology stack options to ensure compatibility and scalability.

risk_report.risk: Poor database design may result in data inconsistencies and query performance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established database design principles and modeling techniques to ensure a robust schema.

risk_report.risk: Ineffective user interface design may lead to poor user experience and low adoption rates.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user research and testing to validate interface design assumptions and identify areas for improvement.

risk_report.risk: Insecure authentication mechanisms may expose user data to unauthorized access.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement industry-standard authentication protocols and follow best practices for secure password storage and transmission.

risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or incomplete nutrition data may compromise the application's credibility and usefulness.
risk_report.mitigation: Source nutrition data from reputable and trustworthy sources, and implement data validation and verification processes.

risk_report.risk: Complex or cumbersome meal logging functionality may deter user engagement and adoption.
risk_report.mitigation: Design an intuitive and user-friendly meal logging interface, with features such as autocomplete and barcode scanning.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate food search functionality may lead to user frustration and decreased application usage.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a robust and efficient search algorithm, with features such as autocomplete, filtering, and sorting.

risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or misleading nutrition summary reports may compromise the application's credibility and usefulness.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement data validation and verification processes to ensure accurate and reliable nutrition summary reports.

risk_report.risk: Ineffective diet goal setting functionality may lead to user dissatisfaction and decreased motivation.
risk_report.mitigation: Design a goal setting interface that is intuitive, flexible, and provides personalized recommendations and feedback.

risk_report.risk: Insecure data export and sharing mechanisms may expose user data to unauthorized access.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement secure data export and sharing protocols, such as encryption and access controls, to protect user data.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate unit testing may lead to undetected bugs and defects in the application.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive unit testing strategy, with a focus on code coverage and automated testing.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate integration testing may lead to compatibility issues and system failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive integration testing strategy, with a focus on system interactions and interfaces.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate user acceptance testing may lead to user dissatisfaction and decreased adoption rates.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage with users and stakeholders to validate application functionality and identify areas for improvement.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate deployment planning and execution may lead to application downtime and data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive deployment plan, with a focus on automation, monitoring, and rollback procedures.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate backup and recovery mechanisms may lead to data loss and system downtime.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a robust backup and recovery strategy, with a focus on data redundancy, automation, and regular testing.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate performance monitoring may lead to undetected issues and decreased application reliability.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a comprehensive performance monitoring strategy, with a focus on real-time metrics, alerts, and analytics.
